pictures.author: Moonik
pictures.observed: Pale end wall with two tall round-headed brown-framed windows, recessed central urn niche and hood, base courses, carved frieze, dentils, deep cornice, lead parapet and capped chimneys.

pictures.author: Moonik
pictures.observed: Long pale garden hall with round-headed wooden entry/short steps, flanking windows and tall flat pilasters; independent Wardrobe Chamber stands separately across the garden gap.

pictures.author: Gryffindor
pictures.observed: Full long garden elevation with two arched entrance groups, tall windows, continuous relief frieze/dentils, flat pilasters and low lead-capped parapet; separate slender chimney stacks above. Trees obscure some middle openings.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Grand/Mecidiye Kiosk: long low pale plaster hall, round-headed brown-framed windows, two real garden entrances and steps, end-wall recessed urn niche, tall flat pilasters, simplified pale carved scroll/rosette reliefs, deep dentil cornice, lead roof behind a low parapet and six capped chimneys. Preserve the independently mapped Wardrobe Chamber and neighbouring terrace/mosque. No copied inscriptions/art, furnished interior or invented dome.
